title: MoEZip: Routing-Aware KV Cache Compression for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.30206v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models scale model capacity efficiently by activating a small subset of parameters per token. However, in long-context inference, memory remains a major bottleneck because the KV cache grows linearly with sequence length. Existing KV cache compression methods reduce this cost for dense transformers, but overlook a problem specific to MoE: KV eviction can change which experts are selected during answer generation, degrading the generation quality. We propose MoEZip, a routing-aware KV cache compression for sparse MoE language models. To estimate the sensitivity of expert routing to perturbation, we propose a novel metric based on the Fisher information matrix of routing distributions. MoEZip combines this metric with attention weights for routing-aware scoring of contexts. Finally, we compose a complementary scoring system that combines eviction methods for dense and sparse-MoE architectures. Experiments

translated_title: MoEZip：面向稀疏混合专家大语言模型的路由感知KV缓存压缩
translated_abstract: 混合专家（MoE）语言模型通过每个token仅激活一小部分参数来高效扩展模型容量。然而，在长上下文推理中，内存仍然是主要瓶颈，因为KV缓存会随序列长度线性增长。现有的KV缓存压缩方法能够降低稠密Transformer的这一成本，但忽略了MoE特有的一个问题：KV驱逐可能会改变答案生成过程中所选择的专家，从而降低生成质量。我们提出MoEZip，一种面向稀疏MoE语言模型的路由感知KV缓存压缩方法。为了估计专家路由对扰动的敏感性，我们提出了一种基于路由分布Fisher信息矩阵的新颖度量指标。MoEZip将该指标与注意力权重相结合，对上下文进行路由感知评分。最后，我们构建了一个互补的评分系统，融合了适用于稠密架构和稀疏MoE架构的驱逐方法。实验……
tldr: 提出MoEZip，一种基于Fisher信息矩阵度量专家路由扰动敏感性的路由感知KV缓存压缩方法，避免KV驱逐改变MoE模型的专家选择，从而提升稀疏MoE大模型长上下文推理的生成质量。
en_tdlr: MoEZip is a routing-aware KV cache compression method that uses a novel Fisher information-based metric to estimate expert routing sensitivity, preventing KV eviction from altering expert selection and thereby improving generation quality for sparse MoE LLMs in long-context inference.
